title: Tools and Output Parsers
summary: This module provides foundational classes and utilities for defining and interacting with tools, alongside a comprehensive suite of output parsers to structure language model responses into various formats.

nodes.label: Base Output Parser
nodes.title: Base Output Parser
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interface for parsing LLM string outputs into structured formats, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: Base Generation Parser
nodes.title: Base Generation Parser
nodes.description: Extends the base output parser to specifically handle and parse language model generation objects, including chat messages.

nodes.label: Comma-Separated List Parser
nodes.title: Comma-Separated List Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output strings into a list of values separated by commas, handling various comma-separated formats.

nodes.label: Numbered List Parser
nodes.title: Numbered List Parser
nodes.description: Extracts items from LLM output formatted as a numbered list, using regular expressions to identify each entry.

nodes.label: Markdown List Parser
nodes.title: Markdown List Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output formatted as a Markdown list, extracting items prefixed with hyphens or asterisks.

nodes.label: Base Transform Parser
nodes.title: Base Transform Parser
nodes.description: A base class for output parsers that can process streaming input, transforming chunks of text or messages into structured outputs.

nodes.label: Cumulative Transform Parser
nodes.title: Cumulative Transform Parser
nodes.description: Extends the base transform parser to handle streaming input cumulatively, optionally yielding diffs between successive parsed outputs.

nodes.label: XML Output Parser
nodes.title: XML Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output formatted as XML, converting it into a dictionary representation and supporting secure XML parsing options.

nodes.label: Datetime Parser
nodes.title: Datetime Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output strings into Python datetime objects, supporting custom format specifications.

nodes.label: Enum Parser
nodes.title: Enum Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a specific enumeration member, validating the output against predefined enum values.

nodes.label: Output Fixing Parser
nodes.title: Output Fixing Parser
nodes.description: Wraps another output parser to automatically attempt to fix parsing errors by re-prompting an LLM with error details.

nodes.label: Pandas DataFrame Parser
nodes.title: Pandas DataFrame Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a structured format that can be used to query or manipulate a Pandas DataFrame.

nodes.label: Retry Output Parser
nodes.title: Retry Output Parser
nodes.description: Wraps another parser and retries on errors, using the original prompt for context in the retry mechanism.

nodes.label: Structured Output Parser
nodes.title: Structured Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a structured dictionary based on a list of defined response schemas, typically expecting JSON markdown.

nodes.label: YAML Output Parser
nodes.title: YAML Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output formatted as YAML into a Pydantic model, handling YAML code blocks and validation.

nodes.label: Anthropic Tools Parser
nodes.title: Anthropic Tools Parser
nodes.description: Specifically designed to parse tool call outputs from Anthropic language models, converting them into structured tool call objects.

nodes.label: Base Tool
nodes.title: Base Tool
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all LangChain tools, defining the core interface for tools that agents can use to perform actions.

nodes.label: Filter Tool Arguments
nodes.title: Filter Tool Arguments
nodes.description: Utility function to filter out specific arguments from a tool's input schema, such as injected runtime parameters.

nodes.label: Infer Tool Schema
nodes.title: Infer Tool Schema
nodes.description: Infers the input argument schema for a tool from a runnable or explicit type hints, facilitating tool definition.

nodes.label: Retriever Tool Async Function
nodes.title: Retriever Tool Async Function
nodes.description: An asynchronous function used within retriever tools to fetch and format documents based on a query.

nodes.label: Legacy Tool Importer
nodes.title: Legacy Tool Importer
nodes.description: A deprecated mechanism for importing tools from the `langchain` package, now recommending `langchain-community`.

nodes.label: Exa Search Tool
nodes.title: Exa Search Tool
nodes.description: Integrates with the Exa API to perform web searches and retrieve results, returning them in a structured JSON format.

nodes.label: Exa Find Similar Tool
nodes.title: Exa Find Similar Tool
nodes.description: Utilizes the Exa API to find web pages similar to a given URL, returning structured results.

nodes.label: Custom Tool Decorator
nodes.title: Custom Tool Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator for creating custom OpenAI-compatible tools, handling schema inference and function wrapping.

groups.label: Core Output Parsing
groups.title: Core Output Parsing
groups.description: Fundamental interfaces for parsing language model outputs.

groups.label: List Format Parsers
groups.title: List Format Parsers
groups.description: Specialized parsers for extracting data from various list formats.

groups.label: Structured Data Parsers
groups.title: Structured Data Parsers
groups.description: Parsers for converting LLM output into structured data types like XML, YAML, Datetime, Enums, and Pandas DataFrames.

groups.label: Streaming Output Parsers
groups.title: Streaming Output Parsers
groups.description: Base classes for handling and transforming streaming language model outputs.

groups.label: Robustness Parsers
groups.title: Robustness Parsers
groups.description: Parsers designed to improve reliability by fixing or retrying parsing operations upon encountering errors.

groups.label: Tool-Specific Parsers
groups.title: Tool-Specific Parsers
groups.description: Parsers tailored for specific tool outputs, such as those from Anthropic models.

groups.label: Core Tooling
groups.title: Core Tooling
groups.description: Foundational components and utilities for defining, managing, and interacting with tools within the LangChain ecosystem.

groups.label: External Service Tools
groups.title: External Service Tools
groups.description: Tools that integrate with and leverage external services like Exa for web search capabilities.

groups.label: Legacy Components
groups.title: Legacy Components
groups.description: Components maintained for backward compatibility, with recommendations for updated usage.
